information: Kubo Open 2016 is one of the year end competion in the Philippines. Kubo is a Filipino term for an English word "cube". That's why is was name Kubo Open 2016. The competition will take place at the Philippine Nikkei Jin Kai International School located at the Mamay Rd, Lanang, Davao City. This will be on the 10th to 11th of December 2016 that will be Saturday and Sunday. Registration is only P250.00 good for 3 events 50 for each of the additional events.
